## Summary

<!-- What does this pull request change and why? -->

## Type of change

- [ ] `feat`: new smell, example or section
- [ ] `fix`: bug in code or error in the docs
- [ ] `docs`: documentation only
- [ ] `refactor` / `test` / `perf` / `style`
- [ ] `build` / `ci` / `chore`

## Checklist

- [ ] The title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/) (`type(scope): description`).
- [ ] Generic smells are mirrored in **all five languages** (Python, C#, React + TypeScript, Go, Angular), or the change does not apply to code.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated, and every affected project passes its checks locally.
- [ ] `python3 tools/build_catalog.py` was run if `tools/catalog_data.py` changed.
- [ ] Commits are signed.
